{{Top|leg}}
A '''Bothan cult''' of fanatical [[ganjuko]]-worshipers existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] members wore a medallion made of ganjuko beak and they were sean wearing dark brown [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]]. 

They knew the location of a hidden [[ganjuko graveyard]] and were willing to [[Death/Legends|kill]] to protect its secret. Occasionally, armed with concealed [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]], they would strike against individuals who knwe were looking for the graveyard, at first as a warning.

Such a group found [[Gart (Human)|Gart]] and prepared to depart [[Tal'cara]] and head to the [[Ragnook Mountains]]. The cultists attempted to stop them as they departed the city and tried to outnumber them. However Gart was actually [[Cladus Glynn]], an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[agent/Legends|agent]]. His [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] associates were secretly shadowing him and his escorts, and sniped at the cultists during the fight, thus allowing the travelers to leave the city.

However members of the cult showed up again in the graveyard, now wearing ganjuko skulls as [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]]; they attacked everyone present, Gart and his group, [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] of [[Beldonna's League]] as well as [[Rathleek's hunting band|Whiphid hunters]] who were fighting each other, only to be joined by ISB agents.
